leadText: Magical Pokémon Journey: Rockabye Pokémon is the twenty-eighth monthly issue released by VIZ Media of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino. It contains the 42nd and 43rd chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of . As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
